scope: historical stop-activity and proximity proxy handoff; not a trained policy or service-benefit estimate

components.name: historical_alight_daily_sum
components.definition: sum pooled training daily alight activity at newly stopped IDs, excluding initial stop
components.interpretation: activity proxy; not unique passengers, OD or new ridership

components.name: normalized_activity_sum
components.definition: same visited-stop sum divided by the frozen complete-training reference maximum

components.name: distinct_proximity_hub_groups
components.definition: newly visited assigned groups; initial stop group already visited
components.interpretation: straight-line proximity preference; not demonstrated transfer benefit

components.name: distance_m
components.definition: sum known directed costs from one explicitly named path/cost version
components.missing_policy: undefined if a required directed cost is absent; never zero-fill

components.name: router_estimated_duration_s
components.definition: same-response profile estimates only when every required route is cached
components.interpretation: car-profile estimates, not observed 07-09 bus time; no dwell-time claim

components.name: stop_count
components.definition: newly stopped IDs excluding the initial stop
components.interpretation: reported operational proxy; not automatically a passenger benefit or an added penalty

components.name: data_coverage_and_quality
components.definition: observed/missing demand, known/unknown costs, source version and measurable quality flags

scalar_baseline.coefficient_evidence: no primary source establishes these values for this population

termination.minimum_service_status: not identified from available data; required before claiming an operational nontrivial bus route
termination.fixed_goal_alternative: declare goal, feasibility, budget, and terminal-score inclusion in a separate model contract

coverage_alternative.definition: F(S)=sum_z w_z * max({0} union {a_zi:i in S}); F(empty)=0; marginal gain F(S union {j})-F(S)
